contract.words: Collect $4,000 of settled cash within 30 days using no up-front capital.

terms.proofCondition: $4,000 of settled cash collected within 30 days

strategy.title: Email-test then sell $200 obituary syndication workbooks to licensed funeral homes
strategy.why: 600 licensed funeral homes are reachable by published business email and posted asking for this work; the $200 price, $5 direct cost, Brain-produced spreadsheet delivery and 5-day time to first cash are evidenced. 20 sales (3.3% of the population) carry $4,000, but no close rate is evidenced, so a first-batch email test measures it before the full send. Payment is taken before delivery so no capital is exposed.

alternatives.title: Send to all 600 homes at once
alternatives.why: Rejected: without a measured close rate it commits the whole list to an untested offer; the staged test reads conversion first.

steps.label: Brain emails a first batch of 150 funeral homes from the published business addresses
Offer the obituary syndication workbook at $200, payment before delivery
Measure reply and paid-close rate on the first batch by day 10
If the test passes, email the remaining 450 funeral homes
Close orders at $200 from both batches
Collect payment before delivery (5 days to first cash)
Brain produces and delivers each paid workbook

quantities.name: paid close rate per contacted home
quantities.needs: Measured by the first-batch email test; at least 3.3% of 600 homes needed

sources.claim: 600 funeral homes licensed by the state board
Published business email addresses; posted asking for this work

validation.proof: By day 10, at least 5 of the first 150 contacted funeral homes have paid $200 (a paid close rate of at least 3.3%), with the cash settled.
stop: Fewer than 2 paid orders from the first 150 homes by day 10
Payments do not settle within 5 days of order
continue: 5 or more paid orders from the first batch by day 10: email the remaining 450 homes
2-4 paid orders: revise the offer and test a second batch of 150 before the full send

brain.summary: Not yet proven. The closest plan is "Only: Obituary syndication workbooks for funeral homes", and what it is missing first is buyers who have actually agreed to it, or a sized measure of how many agree. The reconstruction is hypothetical, not the plan: the reconstruction is flagged implausible (RETURN: median kept [figure withheld] is 1386× the [figure withheld] behind it (bound ×20); SCALE: one deal of "Constructed: Funeral home directors — Obituary syndication w" needs [figure withheld] and keeps [figure withheld], 191× the [figure withheld] behind the plan (bound ×20), on a price no buy), so none of its figures is shown or adopted. The plan's steps are for "Obituary syndication workbooks for funeral homes".

brain.nextTest: Sell "Obituary syndication workbooks for funeral homes": offer it to its reachable buyers at 200 USD for an actual sale, contract or deposit. Each answer is a sale or a refusal, and is recorded as the demand and price evidence. Tie up no more than 0 USD until money comes in.

openings.title: Obituary syndication workbooks for funeral homes

card.offerScope: Obituary syndication workbooks for funeral homes

facts.value: 600 funeral homes are licensed by the state board; each publishes obituaries weekly.
Sell Obituary syndication workbooks for funeral homes to each buyer.

reviews.reasons: CONDITIONAL is right: buyer (600 licensed funeral homes, evidenced), channel, $200 price, $5 cost, Brain delivery and 5-day settlement are evidenced; only the paid close rate is unknown and a 150-home live test measures it with proof (>=5 paid by day 10), stop and continue. 20 x $200 = $4,000 within 30 days at $0 capital; ledger recomputes to $4,000 collected, $100 spent.
findings: Minor: zero margin - at exactly the 3.3% proof threshold the full 600 yields exactly 20 deals/$4,000; any shortfall misses.
Minor: the '2-4 orders' continue branch cannot reach the target on the remaining list unless the revised offer lifts conversion above 3.3%.
Minor: second-batch receipts (day 16) are tied to step 'collect' dated day 5.
